title: feat: tag /v1/models entries by category for Open WebUI's model filter
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `tags` to every `/v1/models` entry in Open WebUI's format (`[{name}]`): the model's category (`text`, `image`, `audio`, `video`, `embedding`, `realtime`, `3d`), plus `community` for community models and `agent` for agents
- Open WebUI's model picker turns these tags into a filter dropdown, so users can show only image models, only agents, and so on
- Adds the field to `OpenAIModelSchema` and the docs example; extends the retrieve and managed-agent tests

Other clients ignore the extra field. Open WebUI needs a production promotion before it sees the tags, and it caches the model list for 5 minutes.

gist.headline: A sorter for the hive
gist.blurb: Every model gets a little label: text, image, audio, and the rest. Open WebUI can turn those labels into a filter dropdown, which beats scrolling past the entire garden.
gist.summary: Every `/v1/models` entry gains Open WebUI-compatible `tags` for its category—text, image, audio, video, embedding, realtime, or 3d—with additional `community` and `agent` tags where applicable.
gist.impact: Open WebUI's model picker can filter for image models, agents, and other tagged groups; clients that do not use tags can ignore the extra field.
